requirement.normalizedRequirement: An operational assessment shall exist and cover low-air-temperature operation, ice operation, high-latitude operation, abandonment onto ice or land, applicable Introduction section 3 hazards, and any identified additional hazards.
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: In order to establish procedures or operational limitations, an assessment of the ship and its equipment shall be carried out, taking into consideration the following: the anticipated range of operating and environmental conditions, such as operation in low air temperature, operation in ice, operation in high latitude, and potential for abandonment onto ice or land; hazards, as listed in section 3 of the Introduction, as applicable; and additional hazards, if identified.
